subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: When does a contract awarded through a public procurement process become legally binding and effective?
options: When the Notice of Intent to Award is posted
When the vendor shakes hands with the buyer
When the written agreement is fully executed (signed) by authorized representatives of both the agency and the vendor
When the first invoice is paid
questions.explain: A public contract is not legally binding until all required signatures from officials with delegated contractual authority (and the vendor) have been affixed to the document.
